title: Account & sync
rowSignedOut: Optional. Keep a copy online and use several phones or the web
notAvailable: Accounts are not available in this version of the app.
intro: An account is optional: everything keeps working without one. With an account, your records are copied to the server and stay the same on all your phones and on the web.
recoveryCodeHint: The code you wrote down when you created the account.
createHint: The account is created for {{shop}}. Records already on this phone are kept and copied to the server.
syncFailed: The last sync did not finish. It will try again automatically.
invalidRecords_one: {{count}} record could not be synced because it is incomplete.
invalidRecords_other: {{count}} records could not be synced because they are incomplete.
signOutMessage: Your records stay on this phone. Changes made while signed out are sent the next time you sign in.
recoveryMessage: This code is the only way to set a new password if you forget it. Keep it somewhere safe. It is shown only once.
passwordChanged: Password changed. Sign in with the new password.

errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Wrong phone number, email or password.
errors.IDENTIFIER_TAKEN: An account with this phone number or email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.CONFLICT: This shop already has an account. Sign in instead.
errors.INVALID_RECOVERY_CODE: Wrong phone number, email or recovery code.
errors.DIFFERENT_SHOP: This account belongs to another shop, and this phone already has records of its own. Use this account on a new phone, or create a separate account for this shop.
errors.NETWORK: Could not reach the server. Check the internet connection and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Check the phone number or email and the password.
errors.SIGNED_OUT: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
